title: Rule-Class Weights for Repeat-Violation Charges — Community Rules & Site Care Schedule
content:
The schedule charge of a repeat-violation charge under Community Rules & Site Care is weighted by the rule class of the notice, the notice being the violation notice most recently served on the plan record.

| Rule class of the notice | Weight on the schedule charge |
|---|---|
| Snow and ice | multiplied by 1.5 |
| Vehicles and parking | multiplied by 1.5 |
| Lawn and landscaping | multiplied by 1.25 |
| Debris and storage | multiplied by 1.25 |
| every other class | not weighted |

The weight multiplies the schedule charge alone; amounts added to the charge are not weighted.

## Hypothetical illustration

| Schedule charge | Rule class | Weighted schedule charge |
|---|---|---|
| $50.00 | lawn and landscaping | $62.50 |
| $100.00 | vehicles and parking | $150.00 |
| $100.00 | debris and storage | $125.00 |
| $50.00 | pets | $50.00 |
